"16 @ War" is the debut single from Karina from her debut album First Love. It was written and produced by Tricky Stewart and The-Dream, while Kuk Harrell provided vocal production. It has spent 8 weeks on the Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs and peaked at #51. It debuted at #93. The song expresses hardships of life from a sixteen-year-old girl's point of view.
